en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ali Bin Al Numan, from Saeed Al A’araj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Two Angels make way for the people on the night of Muzdalifa at the two narrow points’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from him (narrator of previous Hadith) from Ali ibn al-Nu’man from Sa‘id al-’A‘raj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Two angels make room for people who become congested in al-Mazemin.’”
